thread:
mika: Kicking off v2.19.0 rollout to eu-west in change window. Plan: route-by-route, 5 steps, start at 5% for embeddings+rerank.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout_started · job=rl-20260428-19 · step=1 · weights={v2.19.0:5,v2.18.4:95}
ori: Quick FYI 1s after step start embeddings.p95 jumped 180ms -> 520ms and tail 99th spiked. Small uptick in 5xx to 0.4%. SLO panel: https://console.redwood/slo/embeddings?range=10m
slo-watcher: [alert] embeddings.p95 > threshold for 4m · recommend=hold_ramp_and_failover_probe
mika: Holding embeddings ramp only. I want to fail traffic for embeddings to our us-east fallback while we triage the eu-west variant. Don't touch rerank.
devops: Agreed. We'll do a regional failover for embeddings to us-east where v2.18.4 is pinned as last-known-good. Applying regional override now and adding audit note.
devops: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route-region-override -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"embeddings","region":"eu-west","override_region":"us-east","version":"v2.18.4"}'`  # applied
deploy-bot: [automated] regional_failover_applied · route=embeddings · from_region=eu-west · to_region=us-east · target_version=v2.18.4 · job=rl-20260428-19-failover
ori: Watching SLOs: within 60s p95 drops back to ~170ms and 5xx to baseline. Good.
mika: Update release notes: "v2.19.0 embeddings paused in eu-west; regional failover to us-east v2.18.4 applied. Rerank continues ramping. Follow-up: ENG-5605 (eu-west embed triage)."
audit-bot: [log] action=regional-override · user=devops · route=embeddings · override_to=us-east:v2.18.4 · ts=7177770029
mika: We'll keep the rollout job open but blocked for embeddings until ENG-5605 clears. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
